card.name: The word see in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" (or "See") that opens a cross-reference to another label section, table or prescribing information, usually inside brackets or parentheses.

modes.label: Bracketed section pointer
modes.description: "see" right after an opening bracket, pointing to a numbered label section such as Adverse Reactions or Drug Interactions.

modes.label: Parenthetical table or document pointer
modes.description: "see" in parentheses pointing to a table or another prescribing information document.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name a document part or section being referred to, rather than a clear set of next words.
card.plain: It marks the word "see" when a drug label points the reader to another section or table.
